description: Approve and apply a proposal the pricing analyst made (an analyst.* approval, listed in get_analyst_brief and list_approvals). Its stored call runs with your own credential, so the target route checks your role and scopes; only when it succeeds is the proposal approved by you and marked applied. A refusal comes back unchanged and leaves the proposal pending. It runs once even when two applies race. Only the call the action allows runs; anything else is refused. A person, a workspace key, or the agent that owns the workspace may apply; no other agent may, and nobody applies their own request. A proposal already applied runs nothing again and says it was already applied. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

approval_id.description: The proposal approval id, as get_analyst_brief or list_approvals gives it.

reason.description: Why, kept with the approval when this call approves it. Optional.

name: apply_analyst_proposal
